question.value: What are the spectroscopic redshifts, redshift distribution, spectral properties, outflow signatures and SED-derived stellar masses of ALMA-identified SMGs in the ECDFS (ALESS)?

evidence.quote: The first necessary step in this process is to derive the precise spectroscopic redshifts.
taken between October and November 2011 in the Cycle 0 Project #2011.1.00294.S
Each LESS submillimetre source was targeted with ALMA at 870 $\mu$m (Band 7).
determined from serendipitous detections of the \[Cii\]$\lambda$158$\mu$m line in the ALMA band
The typical FWHM of the ALMA synthesised beam was $\sim$ 1.5$''$
the 120 s observations for each source were taken between October and November 2011

evidence.quote: Any emission / absorption features that were identified were fit with a Gaussian profiles to determine their central wavelengths.

findings_qualitative.value: SMGs lie on average a factor ~5 above the main sequence at z=1-3

evidence.quote: the SMGs in our sample lie (on average) a factor $\sim$ 5 above the so-called “main-sequence” at all three redshifts

claims.hypothesis: Radio-independent SMG selection reveals a high-z tail
claims.finding: Sample is not biased against high-z SMGs

evidence.quote: 23% of the ALESS SMGs with spectroscopic redshifts lie at $z>$ 3.

claims.experiment: Velocity offsets between nebular, Lya and UV ISM lines
claims.finding: Likely strong outflows driven mainly by star formation

evidence.quote: it is likely that the extreme SFRs within the SMGs (typically $\sim$ 300 $\pm$ 30 M$_{\odot}$ yr$^{-1}$) are driving strong galaxy-scale outflows

limitations_admitted.value: Redshifts not obtained for 57 observed SMGs; sample biased to bluer sources

evidence.quote: illustrating a modest bias to bluer restframe UV continuua in those SMGs for which we can measure spectroscopic redshifts for
